_comment: Baselines for test/perf-check.mjs. Times are the MINIMUM of PERF_REPS runs of the fixed workload test/perf-suite.smt2. Editing perf-suite.smt2 changes suiteHash and invalidates every entry (the gate fails loudly rather than comparing against different work). Re-record only for a deliberate, explained cost.

ci-ubuntu-x64.note: Measured at PERF_REPS=3 on a GitHub ubuntu-latest x64 runner; CI now runs 5 reps, whose minimum can only be lower, so this baseline is conservative. Observed spread on that runner was 1644-1890ms, which is why the gate compares minimums rather than means.
